label: GO step in the last few trials of the episode, choosing a2 after a reward
explanation: Fires only at GO steps, and only in the last ~10 trials of the episode (ep_trial 90-99 hold 100% of activations; none before trial 80). Its value-head correlate shows the same thing: every activation falls in the lowest value bin (value < 5.22), which matches the value dropping as the episode nears its end. Within that late window it is very selective for the agent choosing a2 (97.6% of mass; model_act == 2) after a rewarded previous trial (98% of mass; in_rew == 0 at GO, prev_reward == 1), mostly in stay runs of a2 when S2 is good. Magnitude rises toward the episode end: in the top windows activation climbs across consecutive rewarded a2 GO steps and peaks at the final trials. It never fires at D1 or D2, never fires on a1 choices (2%), and almost never fires after an unrewarded trial. Scores: GO & ep_trial>=90 gives recall 0.999 but precision 0.11. Adding a2 and prev_reward gives F1 0.44. A threshold of ep_trial>=93 gives F1 0.57 (mass recall 0.94), and >=95 gives F1 0.66 (mass recall 0.85), which is the one recorded. The remaining false positives are similar late a2 GO steps where the feature stays off, so the exact gating (closeness to the end, length of the a2 reward run) is only partly captured. action at GO is the agent own upcoming choice, which is legitimate. No random future outcome is used.
